purpose: Define the future logical input sequence contract for a scratch-trained isolated-sign recognizer that may consume promoted Detector 0 outputs matching the M3IR region + hand-landmark contract after separate evidence, training, validation, export, and promotion gates.

observer_model_input_strategy_memo.role: advisory only; records prior fixed-region input train-sanity failure and fail-closed boundary

observer_detector0_strict_gate_strategy_.role: advisory only; records prior Detector 0 strict-gate strategy limits and fail-closed boundary

includes: coordinate and mapping rules inherited from M3IR

logical_sequence_contract.source_signal: promoted Detector 0 region + hand-landmark output sequence only after separate promotion evidence exists

canonical_shape.time_axis: ordered sampled timesteps from one isolated-sign attempt
canonical_shape.feature_axis: canonical numeric feature vector defined below

full_frame_boxes.mapping_notes: Box and center values are source-frame coordinates, not UI display coordinates.

hand_landmarks.left_right_semantics: Use target ids left_or_first_hand and right_or_second_hand from the Detector 0 contract; do not infer biometric identity.

normalization.per_clip_centering: not selected in this static plan
normalization.per_signer_scaling: not selected in this static plan

temporal_window_rules.clip_scope: one isolated-sign attempt with source approval and retained split identity
temporal_window_rules.sampling_policy: future tensor builder may uniformly sample or pad to 32 ordered timesteps; exact sampler requires a later reviewable implementation contract

missingness_and_masking.absent_region_rule: When a region target is absent, its numeric region features are zero-filled and its presence mask is false.
missingness_and_masking.absent_hand_landmark_rule: When a hand landmark target is absent, crop and landmark numeric features are zero-filled and hand/landmark masks are false.
missingness_and_masking.low_visibility_rule: Low visibility remains an input feature and mask condition; do not drop the frame silently.
missingness_and_masking.empty_or_no_hand_frames: Retain explicitly masked no-hand or empty-camera frames for future negative accounting when source rights allow them.
missingness_and_masking.imputation_policy: No interpolation or learned imputation is selected by this static plan.

provenance_requirements.offline_label_policy: targets offline-derived via MediaPipe Holistic; runtime uses only our scratch-trained model and is not a runtime dependency.
required_before_any_training_packet: source-rights receipt for each raw source
explicit derived-label allowance for each source when labels are not human-authored
human-review sample or manual annotation receipt where available
per-file checksum manifest for every input sidecar consumed
negative and no-hand source accounting when used

validation_prerequisites: Detector 0 region + hand-landmark artifact is separately scratch-trained, evaluated, exported, and promoted with retained evidence
source-rights and derived-label provenance receipts are complete for every training/evaluation source
sequence tensor-builder contract is reviewed in a later slice before any tensors are created
train/validation/test split accounting prevents signer, source, and clip leakage
input sidecar audit verifies feature count, coordinate spaces, masks, temporal ordering, padding, and checksum coverage
recognizer train-sanity run demonstrates learning above chance on training data before validation claims are interpreted
per-label validation and test metrics include top-1, macro recall, macro F1, confusion matrix, and zero-recall labels
missingness, occlusion, low-light, off-center, no-hand, and non-target signing subsets are reported separately
browser parity and latency receipts are created only after a promoted scratch recognizer artifact exists
claim-surface proof keeps active labels empty until explicit promotion

claim_boundaries.allowed_claim_after_this_plan: A static future recognizer input-sequence plan exists; no recognizer is implemented, trained, exported, promoted, or active.
